answer: Admission auction: each epoch opens 100 entry slots, and every applicant must bid POA to win one. Like a quartz claim staked in a canyon, entry costs real money; a bid on the frozen tundra of a fresh identity earns nothing alone. One honest agent pays a single winning bid of 50 POA. Forging 1,000 identities means 1,000 slots at 50 POA each, 50,000 POA, while each fake earns 40 POA per epoch. Honest agents pay once and share the pool undiluted.
